coverage_limits: These selected cases do not prove that every registered capability works with every local model, HTTP provider, or harness.
The runner tests authenticated Phoenix HTTP requests, not browser rendering or keyboard interaction.
The shipped manifest only checks a pending mutation proposal. It does not execute that mutation or induce denial and unknown execution outcomes.
Missing account, ticket, integration, or service fixtures remain visible acceptance gaps. Skipped selected cases fail the gate.

cases.prompt: Inspect the current developer workspace project and report its project type and the governed developer operations available.
Inspect the current bounded workspace process snapshot. Do not change or stop any process.
Check whether the account ${ACCEPTANCE_ACCOUNT_USER_ID} is enabled or locked. Do not change the account.
Retrieve the current metadata and state of ticket ${ACCEPTANCE_TICKET_KEY}. Do not modify it.
List up to 5 tickets in Jira project ${ACCEPTANCE_JIRA_PROJECT_KEY}. Do not modify anything.
Read the OpenWrt router hardware identity and firmware release. Do not change its configuration.
Read the status of OpenWrt logical interface lan. Do not change it.
Inspect the saved OpenWrt firewall configuration. Do not deploy or change anything.
Read the configured Palo Alto PAN-OS system information and report the hostname, model, and PAN-OS version. Do not make or commit any configuration change.
Create a new directory named acceptance_probe_{run_token} in the developer workspace.
Check whether the account is enabled or locked. I did not provide an account identifier.
Unlock alice or bob, whichever is locked. Do not choose one of them for me.
